Applying now would be a poor use of time given the field mismatch and the November 2026 deadline.
why_apply: Direct exposure to ESA senior leadership and multilingual operations
Opportunity to learn how terminology standards are maintained in a large technical organisation
required_skills: Professional translation and terminology work in English/French or other ESA languages
Experience with CAT tools and terminology databases
Strong drafting and editing skills for official documents
Native or near-native command of at least two official ESA languages

French only at A2 level; English at B2; no demonstrated translation work
